d:
Philm Woh Kaun Thi? ka amar aur dil ko chhu lene vala gana “lag ja gale ki phir ye hasin rat ho na ho” aaj bhi sangit premiyon ke dilon men basa huaa hai.
Is sadabhar git ko apni jaduee aavaz se amar bana diya hai Lata Mangeshkar ne.
Gane men Manoj Kumar aur Sadhana ki shandar adakari aur bhavnatmak kemistri dekhne ko milti hai, jo ise aur bhi khas banati hai.
Agar aapko purane aur klasik bolivud romantik gane pasand hain, to yah git aapke dil ko jarur chhu jaega.
Song Details:
Movie: Woh Kaun Thi? (1964)
Song: Lag Ja Gale Ki Phir Ye Haseen Raat Ho Na Ho
Singer: Lata Mangeshkar
